source_data.desc: When you cast **steal warmth** after taking cold damage, you select a living creature within 5 feet of you. That creature takes the cold damage instead, or half the damage with a successful Constitution saving throw. You regain hit points equal to the amount of cold damage taken by the target.
source_data.higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the distance to the target you can affect with this spell increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
source_data.name: Steal Warmth
source_data.reaction_condition: which you take when you take cold damage from magic

ru.description: Когда вы творите **украсть тепло** после получения урона холодом, вы выбираете живое существо в пределах 5 футов от вас.
